scripts.clean: rm -rf core/node_modules dataviz/node_modules storybook/node_modules testing-helpers/node_modules ui/node_modules && npm install
scripts.nuke: rm -rf package-lock.json node_modules core/node_modules dataviz/node_modules storybook/node_modules testing-helpers/node_modules ui/node_modules && npm install
scripts.test: npm run update-coverage-imports && npm run update-test-load-all && npm-run-all test:core test:ui test:dataviz && npm run coverage:total
scripts.test-ci: npm run update-coverage-imports && npm run update-test-load-all && npm run test:core && npm run test:ui && npm run test:dataviz && npm run coverage:total
scripts.test:core: node scripts/test/unit/print-test-runner-notice.js core && cross-env NX_PACKAGE=core web-test-runner --coverage && cross-env NX_PACKAGE=core node scripts/test/unit/inject-zero-coverage.js
scripts.test:ui: node scripts/test/unit/print-test-runner-notice.js ui && cross-env NX_PACKAGE=ui web-test-runner --coverage && cross-env NX_PACKAGE=ui node scripts/test/unit/inject-zero-coverage.js
scripts.test:dataviz: node scripts/test/unit/print-test-runner-notice.js dataviz && cross-env NX_PACKAGE=dataviz web-test-runner --coverage && cross-env NX_PACKAGE=dataviz node scripts/test/unit/inject-zero-coverage.js
scripts.test:watch: npm run update-coverage-imports && npm run update-test-load-all && web-test-runner --watch
scripts.lint:prettier: prettier "**/*.{js,html}" --list-different || (echo '↑↑ these files are not prettier formatted ↑↑' && exit 1)
scripts.lint: npm run lint:polymer && npm run lint:eslint && npm run lint:prettier
scripts.win-lint: npm run win-lint:polymer && npm run lint:eslint && npm run lint:prettier
scripts.format: npm run format:polymer && npm run format:prettier && npm run format:eslint
scripts.win-format: npm run win-format:polymer && npm run format:prettier && npm run format:eslint
scripts.storybook: lerna run analysis --parallel && cd storybook && npm start
scripts.bump-version:date-hash: TIMESTAMP=$(date -u +%Y%m%d.%H%M%S) && lerna exec "npm --no-git-tag-version version \$(node -pe \"require('./package.json').version + '.$TIMESTAMP-' + require('child_process').execSync('git rev-parse --short HEAD').toString()\")" --ignore @nuxeo/nuxeo-elements-storybook
